slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第13章鳄魔铸骨功神明感应篇
“练武还是炼神？”
陆景听到盛姿询问，不由摇了摇头。
他虽然不曾多言，盛姿却自然想到陆景的处境。
陆景在陆府中极不受重视，十六余年以来，陆府也不曾给他安排教习先生，为他武道开蒙。
今天，盛姿询问陆景是炼神还是练武，倒是有些多余了。
陆景其实根本没有选择的余地。
盛姿想到这里，又思虑了些时间，这才笑道：“我盛家虽然不是什么武道贵胄，也没有什么炼神大修，可是府中却也有几本铸骨法门、感应秘典。”
“景公子如果愿意，等我回了府中，便各自选一本练武、炼神的入门法门，差人送到你这里。
你自己细细读上一番，再从中择其一而修。”
一旁的陆漪听到盛姿的话语，脸上露出惊奇之色。
她百思不得其解，为何盛姐姐对着陆景这般看重，铸骨法门、感应秘典对于豪门贵族而言，也不算太过贵重。
但盛姿与陆景不过刚刚相识，甚至又何至于这般为陆景着想？
其实陆漪并不知晓在盛姿眼里，陆景对于中正的理解有何等贵重。
能够让儒学大家钟于柏都为之惊奇，连声追问那见解的出处，便可知其一二。
“我今天帮一帮陆景，就能心安理得的带陆景的见解去换取钟大家的降马之术。
就算陆景余下的体悟平平无奇，换不了降服马术，也可以结一个善缘，卖陆景一个人情。”
盛姿自有考量。
不知道为什么，她心中隐隐有一种预感，总觉得如同陆景这般在逆境之下，仍然能养出不凡气度的少年，未来总能脱出眼下的泥沼，一飞冲天。
“谢过盛家小姐了。”陆景面容上露出和煦微笑，道：“我也不知自己对于中正的见解，是否值得两本法门、秘典。

我先书写一些，盛家小姐带回府中，让那一位客卿读上一读，若是值得，陆景收下无妨，若是不值……”
“叫我盛姿便是。”
盛姿随意一笑：“值不值也是我说了算，景公子你便在家写下见解，我先回府中，选好法门秘典。
到时候差人送来，景公子就将那见解给我府中下人带回来便是。”
盛姿干脆果断，当即站起身来，带着陆漪离开了。
陆景望着盛姿的背影，眼神中不由露出几分欣赏之色。
大伏望族儿女确实不凡，这盛姿比起陆家二少爷陆琼还要来的更英气果敢一些。
“少爷，这盛姿小姐真是令人敬佩，一言一行都不是寻常人家的女儿。”
青玥望着两人离去的背影感叹。
陆景转身回房：“她自然不是什么寻常人家的女儿，太枢阁次辅大臣……即便是来了这神霄伯府，神霄伯都要亲自前去迎接。”
青玥似懂非懂，可是脸上却由衷的笑着：“不管如何，我只觉得盛姿小姐对少爷极有好感，还要给少爷送来典籍。”
“不过，少爷伱真的要练武吗？府中不曾给你配给教习，如果擅自……”
青玥的担忧不无道理。
勋贵世家自然有严厉的家规。
尤其是武勋世家，贸然学习族外的法门……这样的事可大可小。
可如果落在陆景的身上，就必然是一件大事。
可陆景却已然顾不得这些了。
他如今的处境已经极为艰难，往后不知还要遭遇多少的磨难。
如果没有一技傍身，又如何能够逃离世间的枷锁？
更何况现在的陆景并不是孤身一人，身旁青玥始终不离不弃，陆景不求其他，我觉得至少要让青玥过上其他院里丫鬟的生活。

再不济，每日都要食肉。
“青玥十分喜欢吃那桃花酥，方才眉眼里的每一处，都洋溢着幸福和满足。”
陆景心中思索。
他步入房中，准备写下中正见解之前，回头对青玥柔声道：“我向来不喜欢吃甜食，这剩下的桃花酥，你再拿回房里收起来，平日里也可以解一下馋。”
青玥小心翼翼的将檀盒抱在怀里，刚想要说些什么，却看到陆景已经关上房门，大约是写字去了。
“谢谢少爷。”
青玥好像是在自言自语，只是眼中的温柔都化开在她黑色的瞳孔中，多出了几分光彩。
盛府距离陆府本来便不远，都在这十里长宁街上。
不过两个时辰，陆漪不情不愿的领着一位长着落腮胡，躯体魁梧，眼神锐利的青年，来到陆景的院前。
“公子，我名为周褚，我家小姐命我为你送来两本典籍，都在这包裹中了。”
周褚站在陆景身前说话，陆景只觉得一股灼热的气息直刺他的面目。
这魁梧青年，就好像是一架火炉一般，令人惊异。
“这青年气血旺盛，眼神锐利，身上的肌肉虬起，必然是一位武道强者。”
陆景并不多言，只是将一刻钟之前才写好的中正注解交给周褚，又让他给盛姿带去自己的谢意。
周褚这便离开。
陆漪则也往回走了几步，忽然转身提醒道：“喂，陆景，我听大兄说过，若无教习指导，贸然练武炼神，恐怕会伤及肉体、大脑。
你小心些，免得到时候钟夫人问起来，我脱不开责任。”
这小妮子说完便傲娇转身，两条马尾晃晃悠悠，一荡一荡。
“陆漪小姐是二府朱夫人的掌上明珠，二府老爷醉心礼佛，平日里连朱夫人都见不到他，每个月却总要唤陆漪小姐过去。
刁蛮一些也是正常，少爷莫要往心里去。”

青玥大概是怕陆景生气，平白烦恼，便出声开导陆景。
可陆景脸上仍带着笑意，陆漪话里带着好意，但是却拉不下脸面，这一点陆景当然听出来了。
“不去理她。”
陆景对青玥道：“晚上买些肉食回来，做一顿好的。”
青玥答应下来，又有些担忧的望着陆景手里的包裹：“少爷，陆漪小姐说话虽然极不客气，但她说的一定是实情。
你要练武、炼神，可不能操之过急。”
陆景答应下来，回到房中郑重
只见那包裹中，有两本典籍，
第一本典籍是一本武道法门，因为封面上清晰的写着：“《鳄魔铸骨功》！”
第二本典籍是一本炼神秘典——《神明感应篇》！
昨天发烧睡着了，半夜报备，又连做了好几次核酸导致更新晚了。
以后每天下午五点、晚上九点各一章，雷打不动。
content_en:
Chapter 13: Crocodile Demon Bone Casting Skill and Divine Induction Chapter
"Practice martial arts or practice god?"
Lu Jing couldn't help but shook his head when he heard Sheng Zi's question.
Although he didn't say much, Sheng Zi naturally thought of Lu Jing's situation.
Lu Jing was not taken seriously in the Lu Mansion. For more than sixteen years, the Lu Mansion had not arranged for him to have a teacher to teach him the martial arts.
Today, it was a bit redundant for Shengzi to ask Lu Jing whether he was practicing god training or martial arts.
Lu Jing actually had no choice at all.
Sheng Zi thought of this, thought about it for some time, and then smiled and said: "Although my Sheng family is not a martial arts noble, nor does it have any major spiritual training, but there are several bone-casting techniques and induction secret books in the house."
"If Mr. Jing is willing, when I return to the house, each of you will choose a book on martial arts and spiritual training and send it to you.
Read it carefully yourself, and then choose one of them to practice. "
Lu Yi on the side had a look of surprise on his face when he heard Sheng Zi's words.
She couldn't understand why Sister Sheng valued Lu Jing so much. The bone-casting method and the secret code of induction were not too valuable for wealthy nobles.
But Shengzi and Lu Jing had just met, so why did they even care about Lu Jing so much?
In fact, Lu Yi didn't know how valuable Lu Jing's understanding of Zhongzheng was in Sheng Zi's eyes.
The great Confucian scholar Zhong Yubai was astonished by it, and he kept asking about the source of that opinion, and then he could find out one or two reasons.
"If I help Lu Jing today, I can bring Lu Jing's insights in exchange for Zhong's horse-subduing skills with peace of mind.
Even if the rest of Lu Jing's understanding is mediocre and cannot be exchanged for horseback riding, he can still form a good relationship and sell Lu Jing a favor. "
The grand appearance has its own considerations.
She didn't know why, but she had a vague premonition in her heart. She always felt that a young man like Lu Jing who could still develop extraordinary magnanimity under adversity would always be able to get out of the current quagmire and soar into the sky in the future.
"Thank you, Miss Sheng." Lu Jing said with a warm smile on his face, "I don't know if my views on Zhongzheng are worth two books of Dharma and secret books.
I'll write some first, and Miss Sheng will take it back to the house and let the guest read it. If it's worth it, Lu Jing can accept it. If it's not worth it..."
"Just call me Shengzi."
Shengzi smiled casually: "Whether it's worth it or not is up to me. Mr. Jing, you can write down your opinions at home. I'll go back to the mansion first and select the secret book of the method.
When the time comes, I will send someone to deliver it, and Young Master Jing will bring that insight back to my servants. "
Sheng Zi was decisive, stood up immediately, and left with Lu Yi.
Lu Jing looked at Sheng Zi's back with a hint of admiration in his eyes.
The sons and daughters of the famous Dafu family are indeed extraordinary, and their appearance is even more heroic and courageous than that of Lu Qiong, the second young master of the Lu family.
"Young Master, this graceful young lady is really admirable. She is not an ordinary daughter in every word and deed."
Qing Yue sighed as she looked at the two people leaving.
Lu Jing turned around and went back to his room: "She is certainly not the daughter of an ordinary family. She is the Second Assistant Minister of Taishu Pavilion... Even if she comes to Uncle Shenxiao's Mansion, Uncle Shenxiao will personally go to greet her."
Qingyue seemed to understand, but she smiled sincerely on her face: "No matter what, I just think that Miss Shengzi has a great affection for the young master, and she also wants to send him classics."
"But, Master, do you really want to practice martial arts? The government has never allocated training to you. If you do it without authorization..."
Qingyue's worries are not unreasonable.
A noble family naturally has strict family rules.
Especially for the Wuxun family, rashly learning methods from outside the clan... Such a thing can be big or small.
But if it falls on Lu Jing, it will definitely be a big deal.
But Lu Jing no longer cares about this.
His current situation is already extremely difficult, and he doesn't know how many more hardships he will face in the future.
If you don’t have any skills, how can you escape from the shackles of the world?
What's more, Lu Jing is not alone now.People, Qing Yue will never leave her, Lu Jing doesn’t ask for anything else, I think at least let Qing Yue live the life of a maid in other courtyards.
No matter how bad it is, you have to eat meat every day.
"Qingyue likes to eat that peach blossom cake very much. Every part of her eyebrows was filled with happiness and satisfaction."
Lu Jing thought in his mind.
He walked into the room, and before he was about to write down Zhongzheng's opinion, he turned around and said softly to Qingyue: "I never like sweets. You can take the remaining peach blossom cakes back to the room and put them away. You can also satisfy your craving on weekdays."
Qing Yue carefully held the sandalwood box in her arms. Just when she was about to say something, she saw that Lu Jing had already closed the door and was probably writing.
"Thank you, Master."
Qingyue seemed to be talking to herself, but the tenderness in her eyes was reflected in her black pupils, giving her a little more brilliance.
The Sheng Mansion is not far from the Lu Mansion, both on Changning Street within ten miles.
Within two hours, Lu Yi reluctantly led a young man with a beard, a burly body, and sharp eyes to the front of Lu Jing's courtyard.
"Sir, my name is Zhou Chu. My lady ordered me to bring you two classics, both of which are included in this package."
Zhou Chu stood in front of Lu Jing and spoke, and Lu Jing felt a hot breath piercing his face.
This burly young man is astonishingly like a furnace.
"This young man has strong energy, sharp eyes, and bulging muscles. He must be a strong martial artist."
Lu Jing didn't say much. He just handed Zhou Chu the Zhongzheng annotation he had written a quarter of an hour ago and asked him to bring his gratitude to Sheng Zi.
Zhou Chu then left.
Lu Yi also took a few steps back, then suddenly turned around and reminded, "Hey, Lu Jing, I heard my eldest brother said that if you practice martial arts without guidance, you may injure your body and brain.
You should be careful, lest Mrs. Zhong asks about it later and I cannot escape responsibility. "
After saying this, the little girl turned around proudly, her two ponytails swaying.
"Miss Lu Yi is the apple of Mrs. Zhu's eye. The master of the second house is obsessed with worshiping Buddha. Even Mrs. Zhu can't see him on weekdays, but she always calls Miss Lu Yi every month.
It's normal to be a bit unruly. Master, don't take it personally. "
Qingyue was probably worried that Lu Jing would be angry and was just worried, so she spoke up to enlighten Lu Jing.
But Lu Jing still had a smile on his face, and Lu Yi had good intentions in his words, but he couldn't lose face. Of course Lu Jing could tell.
"Ignore her."
Lu Jing said to Qing Yue, "Bring some meat back tonight and make a good meal."
Qing Yue agreed and looked at the package in Lu Jing's hand with some worry: "Master, although Miss Lu Yi is very rude in what she says, she must be telling the truth.
If you want to practice martial arts and refine your skills, don’t do it too hastily. "
Lu Jing agreed and returned to the room to solemnly
I saw two classics in the package.
The first classic is a martial arts book, because it clearly says on the cover: "The Crocodile Demon Bone Casting Technique"!
The second tome is a mystical refining tome - "Divine Induction"!
Yesterday I had a fever and fell asleep. I reported it in the middle of the night and did several nucleic acid tests in a row, which caused the update to be late.
From now on, there will be one chapter each at five o'clock in the afternoon and one chapter at nine o'clock in the evening, which is unstoppable.
